::: {#exm-squared-prediction-error}
#### Squared prediction error of one prediction
<!-- no-figure: a single prediction and outcome; there is nothing to plot -->

For the prediction $\fitted = 7$ of the observed outcome $y = 2$,
the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) is $\prederr = 7 - 2 = 5$,
so the [squared prediction error](#def-squared-prediction-error) is

$$\sqprederr = \sqf{5} = 25.$$
:::
